card.name: Last digit or 'million' in big numbers
card.fires_on: The final digit of a long number, or the word 'million', where a count, distance or year is being written. Common in numbers like 10,000, 16,029 and years like 2012.

modes.label: Number ending
modes.description: The last digit of a large number or a year, often just before a unit or noun such as patients or WY.

modes.label: The word million
modes.description: The word 'million' after a number, in distances.
modes.example: During the 2011 closest approach in early September, it will be 10.9<< million>> miles (17.5 million kilometers

modes.label: Year ending
modes.description: The last digit of a year in a dated headline.
modes.example: Wed April 11, 201<<2>> What Would The Buffett Rule Mean For

card.writes: It lowers the chance of a year-word such as Chinese 年 coming next, so the model expects a unit or noun instead.
card.plain: It marks the end of a big number or year, where a unit or noun comes next rather than a year word.
